name: Yusa Chieri
source:
A first year in high school cousin of Aimi, Yumeno and Saki. She lives in Tsukimori Village and attends the school in nearby town.

Chieri has a very extroverted personality and immediately gets attached to Taiki. Although she is just a year younger than Aimi, she is often mistaken for being much younger. Since she is a single daughter, in the village she stuck to Aimi and others at all times.

She easily gets lonely and acts very spoiled towards others. However, when Saki, Yumeno and Aimi left the village she respected their will and quietly saw them off.

Although she doesn't think of what she wants to do in future, she loves the life in the village and won't even think about leaving it.
